items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: but John Chilton wrote to me about Bob Fuller

ctx.x: Oh, I see -- played nothing but

-- (unintelligible) clarinet, but John Chilton wrote to me about Bob Fuller and was he still living, where was he born and about Henry Supporo. Well, Supporo's a boy in New Orleans, and he had his own group around New York. I worked with him. Then we had the last group Lasko was Bamboo Inn in the band -- marine up on 7th Avenue, you know, and 140th Street. But Bob Fuller was with Mamie Smith when I first heard him, and they had -- they wanted me to join the band and wanted to get rid of Bob. But I wasn't ready…
I mean now, where did Bob Fuller come from?
